source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to code testing and debugging (PDF 64).

blocks.text: Yeh chapter code ki testing aur debugging ki bunyadi techniques sikhata hai taake programs durust chalein. Yeh batata hai ke qabil-e-aitbaar applications ke liye testing kyun ahem hai aur programming ki aam ghaltiyan kaun si hain. Is mein Python ke unittest aur pytest modules se unit testing, test cases likhna aur chalana, aur breakpoints, watch expressions aur qadam ba qadam chalane se debugging shamil hai. Phir yeh exception handling, kai qism ke exceptions samet, aur aakhir mein performance napne aur rukawatein (bottlenecks) dhoondne ke liye profiling aur optimisation samjhata hai.

blocks.title: Testing aur debugging
blocks.text: Testing program ko jaanchna hai taake yaqeeni ho ke woh durust chalta aur mutawaqqa output deta hai. Debugging program ki ghaltiyan (bugs) dhoondna aur theek karna hai.

blocks.prompt: Testing aur debugging mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Testing jaanchti hai ke program mutawaqqa nataij deta hai ya nahi aur batati hai ke kuch ghalat hai; debugging maloom masle ki wajah dhoond kar use theek karti hai.

items: Testing: kya program mutawaqqa output deta hai?
Debugging: bugs dhoondna aur theek karna.
Yeh chapter: unit tests, breakpoints, watches, exceptions, profiling.
